data.title: Trump Defends Unfreezing Iran Funds as Senate Rebukes Him on War
data.description: President Donald Trump said Iran will be able to use funds released from frozen accounts only to purchase food and medical supplies from the US, seeking to ease concerns about peace negotiations that both sides say are making progress.
